+def _completion_nudge(state: RunState, options: LoopOptions, now: float) -> str | None:
+    if state.finalization_started:
+        return None
+    turns_left = options.max_turns - state.turn_count
+    wall_left = state.deadline_monotonic - now
+    if turns_left > options.max_turns * 0.4 and wall_left > options.max_wall_time_sec * 0.4:
+        return None
+    return (
+        "Budget is getting short. If the task already appears solved, stop exploring or "
+        "polishing and use finish now with one to three focused, self-contained checks that "
+        "exercise the real deliverable. A rejected finish needs spare turns for repair, so do "
+        "not wait until the last turns."
+    )
+
